notes.title: Update 1 : Blueprints & Sloped Conveyors
notes.content:
[h1][/h1][previewyoutube="ReKH838XPao;full"][/previewyoutube][h1]Update 1 Change Log[/h1][h3]Compatibility[/h3][p]You can bring 0.4.x saves forward to 0.5.x. There are no known breaking changes. Version 0.4.53 will remain available on the prior branch.[/p][h2]
New Feature: Blueprints[/h2][list][*][p]Duplicate anything from a single building to your whole factory and place directly or save as a blueprint.[/p][/*][*][p]Copy designs between saves or export them to share with your friends.[/p][/*][*][p]Blueprint you favorite mining or farming beacon layout.[/p][/*][*][p]Blueprints include all settings and scripts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fully automate factory expansion using the surveyor to automatically place blueprints.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]New Feature: Conveyor on Slopes[/h2][list][*][p]Conveyors can now go up and down slopes of 1 tile up for every horizontal tile.[/p][/*][*][p]Drag out a line of conveyor and it will automatically follow the contour of the land.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]New Feature: Steam Achievements[/h2][p]7 Achievements with more to come.[/p][p][/p][h2]UI Update: Build & Selection Hot Bar[/h2][list][*][p]10 row 10 slots which you can assign as you choose and bind to the keyboard.[/p][/*][*][p]Slots can build any building, place blueprints, or selecting entities by team or role.[/p][/*][*][p]Export and import Roles and blueprints and shareable strings.[/p][/*][*][p]Build mode multi-select supports copy, blueprint, deconstruct, and restore.[/p][/*][*][p]Shift-click to add and remove entities from selections.
[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Scripting Features[/h2][list][*][p]Drones now descend slowly (3 tiles down for every 1 across) letting them move faster and use less power when moving over rough terrain[/p][/*][*][p]Three new team colors.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Else If[/b] block.[/p][/*][*][p][b]When[/b] can now store the signal sender in a memory.[/p][/*][*][p]Surveyors can place blueprints.[/p][/*][*][p]Crane give and take commands now respect requests in a similar way to conveyors.[/p][/*][*][p]New "self" target.[/p][/*][*][p]Crane "Go To Self" can go to high points or low points in the entire reachable area in of the crane letting you flatten the entire disk with no need for a beacon.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]New Buildables[/h2][list][*][p]Long bridge can cross over three conveyors or span the tile gaps in the terrain.[/p][/*][*][p]Build three (cosmetic) statues: a copper drone, a steel drone, and a gold drone.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Early Access Out Now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Icaria is now officially launched into Early Access after nearly 6 years in development. I’ll start this post with a quick rundown of the new content, then go over our plans for what’s next.
[h3]New Robots[/h3]
The rover, a robot that walks along the terrain and is perfect for bulk transport of items. 
The surveyor, a new moving programmable entity that functions like a beacon.
Heavy drones, slow moving drones that can hold up to 10 items. These provide a really interesting scripting challenge, I’m excited to see what people do with them. 
[h3]Fluids[/h3]
The game now has fluids! 
Pipes, pumps, and liquid storage tanks,  which let you handle fluid logistics. 
2 new crafting buildings, the Chemical Factory and the Refinery, let you do high-tech manufacturing using fluids. 
A new high efficiency, large radius generator that runs on liquid fuel. 
[h3]New Resources[/h3]
Gold, a precious new resource used for crafting drones, rovers, surveyors, and heavy drones. 
[h3]New Tech Tiers[/h3]
The game now has 2 new tech tiers!
These tiers contain all the previously mentioned new content, as well as dual lane conveyors. 

Thank you for all the support in the year our demo has been out. Icaria has improved so much thanks to the people providing feedback, filing bug reports, and experimenting in the game. And this is just the start! 

[h1]What’s Next?[/h1]
For the next month or so, we will be focusing on bug fixes, balance changes, and quality of life improvements. Some of the things to expect in the short term are
[list]
[*] Rover tutorial
[*] QoL improvements for pipe building and dual lane conveyors.
[*] Steam Cloud Saves.
[*] Lots of smaller UI improvements.
[/list]
In the mid-term we’ll be working on a few bigger improvements. These are some of the things on our list but we’ll be listening to the community for suggestions and priorities.
[list]
[*] Text-based scripting 
[*] More scripting features
[*] Blueprints (includes allowing you to place construction sites using scripts!)
[*] Some cool new toys to play with in the early to mid game.
[/list]
Finally, when we get to extending the progression and major content additions, these are some of the ideas we’re looking at. Again, we’ll definitely be guided by the community as we choose our direction.
[list]
[*] Boats and other islands
[*] An enemy
[*] Flowing fluid in the terrain
[*] Upgrade modules
[*] A story that leads to a nominal end.
[/list]
The order in which we prioritize new features will be based on what the community feedback. If you’d like to give feedback, the best way is via our discord server: https://discord.gg/XyY9dXqe

notes.title: Small Update: Demo 0.3.57
notes.content:
[list]
[*] There is now a new first person camera controller. The difference is the first person camera controller rotates around the camera center rather than trying to rotate around the thing you are looking at. It also maintains a strictly fixed altitude unless you run the camera into the terrain. The old camera controller is still available in the general settings as "third person."
[*] Drones now validate their destination tile and retarget if they are within 10 tiles of their destination. This only applies to go to commands that are going to an area. A tile will trigger a retarget if it is occupied by another drone, if it no longer matches the terrain filter, or if it is no longer the highest/lowest tile in the area (if one of those options is chosen).
[*] Drones are better at finding their way around blockades. If they get stuck they'll start using a bit of semi-random search to find their way out.
[*] Don't delete beacons unless you actually click on the beacon.
[*] Adjust the reference height for the construction effect on the conveyor bridge.
[*] Fix drones going to a point stored in memory.
[*] Fix the "discovered crashed lander" message.
[*] Show all tree types in the item picker.
[*] Biomass is now a material rather than an ore.
[*] Fix a performance issue in saves with lots of actions.
[*] Performance fix when there are lots of drones targeting empty beacons.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update: Demo 0.3.53
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix the tree simulation so trees don't die out over time.
[*] Rebalance the tree growth parameters so we get a nice long-term balance of species on most maps.
[*] Change factory crafting so it draws energy over time during a craft rather than all at once at the start.
[*] Reduce the power consumption of the printer.
[*] Increase the duration of the printer recipes.
[*] Reduce the battery size of all crafting buildings because, with incremental draw, the large battery is no longer needed.
[*] Add a confirmation box if you close the game window in windowed mode.
[*] Frame rate setting in graphics. Large factories will run better at 60fps (or less) because that is the rate the simulation runs at and trying to squeeze a simulation step in an 8ms window at 120fps is rough.
[*] Search will now find floating logs and beacons will highlight logs in water even if the terrain filter is set to "no water."
[*] "if requested by" now returns negative numbers it the target has more items than it is requesting.
[*] Fix a case where rotating a conveyor segment breaks the whole conveyor.
[*] Set the team to the default when repairing a building.
[*] Don't count space on conveyors when calculating building free space.
[*] Significant performance improvements particularly for factories with lots of conveyor belts.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update: Demo 0.3.46
notes.content:
[b]Update to Unity 2022.3.59f1[/b]
This isn't a major version update, we've been on 2022.3 for quite a while. However this update comes with a lot of bug fixes. We were prompted to update now because we have gotten feedback from some players that the game is very slow to quit after a long play sessions and this update seems to help. Hopefully it also comes with broader hardware compatibility.

[list]
[*] Fix # & @ queries for Conveyor Loaders.
[*] The list of things you can test in the expression editor is now changes with the entity type.
[*] Conveyor Loaders can, once again, test source and destination properties.
[*] Protect against loading a deleted entity in the UI.
[*] Fix a bunch of issue with conveyor bridges crossing other bridges. Not sure I have all the edge cases yet but it is better.
[*] Fix construction and deconstruction of the Tower Crane.
[*] Disable deconstruction of Relays. You pick them up with a drone to get the antenna back
[*] Remember now works with targets by ID.
[*] New expression term: "count of" returns the count of an entity type or role.
[*] Several of the "other" expression terms (like area and distance) now return a large negative number so it is easy to know whether the target exists or not.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update: Demo 0.3.42
notes.content:
Thanks to all of you who played our game over Next Fest (and before too)! There's nothing like a large influx of players to help you find a bunch of issues in the game that need fixing.

[b]Features and Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] New expression terms that use memories rather than target or tags.
[*] Sort items in inventory displays.
[*] Portable generators now are 100% efficient and have the same priority as the small bioreactors.
[*] Most commands can now resolve to self.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Make sure save directories are not read only so it is possible to delete them. This is a work around for a quirk of OneDrive
[*] AbortIf now can properly abort loops.
[*] Robot arms are now back to their original steel color.
[*] Fix the layout of the Item popup on 800p displays.
[*] Don't let the item picker go off the bottom of the screen.
[*] Fix for assembly drones occasionally going AWOL and running off the map.
[*] If On Tile now looks at entity types and even into storages.
[*] Leveler radius text is now correct.
[*] Remember the conveyor placement rotation.
[*] Make sure the "have I ever built a crane" state gets saved.
[*] Replacing a conveyor loader with a junction behaves very badly. Fix a couple problems so the factory comes back up in a reasonable state, but also don't let the player place a junction there because it isn't going to connect anyhow.
[*] Catch a few more errors I've seen in the logs.
[/list]

notes.title: Icaria Demo Update 3!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Brand new terrain generation. Much more realistic, physically based terrain generation.
[*] The trees are alive! 8 species of tree each with their own preferred environments. They grow up, seed the next generation, and die naturally. You can collect their seeds to plant them, change the environment to affect how they grow, and farm them for the best source of power (currently) in the game.
[*] Automatic building construction with drones. They’ll find resources in your storages to assemble buildings and tear down deconstruction sites and put away the items in storages that accept them.
[*] Reworked start to the game without the tower crane. Choose where you want to start building and create more flexible factories when all your stuff doesn’t live in one central store. Cranes are still a tech upgrade later in the game.
[*] New optional in-game tutorial. The “new player start” walks you through the start until you build a garage; you can then save and continue the game from the tutorial or start over and do it your own way.
[*] Limit One construction mode pauses crafting when there is one product in factory storage making it easy to craft on demand.
[*] Beacon auto-hide makes spreading beacons over a larger area much easier because drones will no longer find beacons when they run out of resources.
[*] Lots of small QoL changes and bug fixes. In my experience the game plays smoother now than it ever has.
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Small Update: Demo 0.1.15
notes.content:
All these changes came from player feedback.
[list]
[*] Lower the contrast of the lighting–there are now controls for lighting in graphics settings.
[*] New item picker UI.
[*] Adjust the HUD panel sizes; info and palette panels are narrower; editor is wider.
[*] Rework some of the item icon sizes so things are a bit more consistent.
[*] Smooth over a rough patch in the Manufacturing training.
[*] In the tutorial, note when the building/robot being pointed to is behind the UI or offscreen.
[*] Fix a case affecting some seeds where it was impossible to finish the demo mission.

[*] The script location markers now point to the beacon rather than the nearest point in the beacon area.
[*] Hover and right clicking in a beacon area now goes to the point, not the beacon. Shift right-click still goes to the beacon.
[*] Fix some bugs in the conveyor item filter UI.
[*] Fix load/save when setting the wildcard request on a building to 0.
[*] Control-click now has a beep when you copy robot settings.

[/list]

Thanks for all your posts, comments, and ideas! We're continuing to fix things and your suggestions make a big difference.

[h1]Change List[/h1]

notes.title: Small Update: Demo 0.0.23
notes.content:
[h3]Major Crash[/h3]
On machines localized to use a comma for the decimal place, the terrain generation would get stuck in an infinite loop and eventually run out of memory and crash. We've fixed that and done a sweep of the code for other places where localization can break things. We may not have caught them all yet but the the major stability issues are fixed.

[h3]Broken Tutorials[/h3]
Depending on how fast you went through the tutorials, some of them would get into a state where the couldn't be finished.

[h3]Missing Shadows[/h3]
Buildings, robots, and trees were sometimes missing shadows. We've seen our shadows again so there will be six more weeks of winter (Ground Hog Day joke for the Americans out there.)

[h3]Training Update[/h3]
We've updated some of the trainings to hopefully to a better job of introducing the core game mechanics. Expect us to continue to work on the intro and tutorials over the coming weeks.

[h3]Minor Bug Fixes[/h3]
We've fixed a few rare and minor issues that showed up in the logs.

notes.title: Small Update: Demo 0.0.20
notes.content:
[list]
[*] We've seen a bug where we don't handle some localization settings correctly and "New Game" results in an error message. Hopefully we've fixed that; we'll be watching for it in the logs.
[*] There is also a bug where some computers are seeing only black for terrain textures. That looks like it connected to particular hardware--most likely specific CPUs. We're working on it and hope to have a fix soon.
[*] We've fixed the layering on the Start Menu so the Discord and Steam logos don't sit on top of the settings dialog.
[*] A few other minor fixes.
[/list]
Were working on it; there's more on the way.

notes.title: Icaria Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Some of you might have noticed that Steam is now showing Icaria Demo as available. The truth is: not yet, but soon. We've been working with a fantastic group of play testers since the beginning of January, turning their feedback into fixes and features, and working through more mundane things like settings and Steam integration. So far it looks like we're on track to release the demo by the end of February.
[h3]What To Expect[/h3]
The demo includes a tutorial which introduces the automation systems and many of the early game mechanics. In addition you can play through the game up to the first major milestone with two different difficulty settings. We've trimmed the first milestone a bit, but there are still several hours of game to play.

We've still got a lot of work to do for a full release; during that time we'll be updating the demo with changes to balance and difficulty, quality of life, and other updates to keep it in sync with development of the full game. In addition we'll be listening carefully to the community for feedback and ideas that will guide ongoing development. Icaria is an experiment and it regularly surprises us as we learn what it truly needs to be. We are hoping you will join in that conversation.
